text:
nina: Beginning regional split rollout for llm-router v6 in EU region in 5m. Plan: 1% EU-canary -> 10% -> 50% over 30m. Gates: p95 +100ms, 5xx spike >20/5m, or auth failures >0.5%. Quiet windows avoided.

omar: FYI I'll be oncall. Please list exact ffctl/ops commands so I can act fast.

nina: commands below and note we27re using attribute-based split (by region header). Warmup will include EU long-context set.

```
# warmup EU samples
infractl warmup --model=llm-router-v6 --samples=eu-longtail --ttl=10m
# set EU canary to 1%
ffctl set llm-router_v6 --cohort=eu-canary --pct=1 --by=region_header
# rollback: remove v6 from EU and pin back to v5
ffctl set llm-router_v6 --cohort=eu-canary --pct=0
ffctl pin llm-router --version=v5 --cohort=default --reason="eu_canary_safe_revert"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Warmup completed; sample cache hit 92%. EU canary scheduled (6643210000).

oncall-bot: ALERT: auth failure rate in EU-canary rose to 0.8% (threshold breached) 30s ago.

omar: seeing the same in traces, failures are downstream auth service 401s for a subset of EU tenants routed to canary.

sre: looks like header mapping for region header missing for some proxies; routing mismatch. Pushing a proxy rule fix now.

nina: hold ramp. Do not move to 10%. If proxy fix will take >10m, execute rollback to avoid customer impact.

omar: agreed. Initiating fast rollback to remove v6 from EU-canary and pin default to v5.

```
# execute rollback
ffctl set llm-router_v6 --cohort=eu-canary --pct=0
ffctl pin llm-router --version=v5 --cohort=default --reason="eu_auth_401s"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback executed: v6 removed from EU-canary; v5 pinned for default (6643210068). Audit logged.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: https://go.redwood/incident/1255  EU auth failures during canary; auto-rollback executed.

sre: proxy-mapping fix deployed to canary infra; running validation tests for header mapping and auth handshakes.

nina: thanks. Will re-run warmup with the problematic tenant set and re-run canary with a narrower cohort (internal beta only) once infra confirms fix. Update release notes with rollback and mitigation steps.

omar: monitoring loop open for 30m. Closing this ops thread but keeping incident linked.

nina: thread closed.
